value.rationale: It determines a natural hard-to-derive domination invariant for every complete tripartite graph with part sizes >=2 and p>=3, revealing a third-part auxiliary-label regime. The infinite balanced threshold yields the exact constant optimum five and precise count 3a^3 of minimizers, not only a one-off example. The p=2 total-strong third-vertex phenomenon is acknowledged; value arises from exact generalized capacity optimization and extremal census.
